jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Data Platform (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At  Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.  Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.  We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.  Are you ready to join us?     Your Job   As  Engineering Manager, Data Platform  at Statista, you’ll lead the engineers building a platform-as-a-product that helps teams manage and share trusted data. You’ll make it easier for data producers to get started while ensuring the platform is secure, reliable and cost-conscious as it grows.  You’ll work closely with the Senior Platform Product Manager: they lead product vision and priorities; you lead the people, technical delivery and day-to-day operation of the platform. The role spans Snowflake-based data infrastructure and event streaming via Kafka.      What You’ll Do      Lead and grow the team.  Lead a mixed team of DevOps, software and data engineers with shared ownership, on-call and standards. Grow people through clear expectations, regular feedback and real ownership, and hire as the platform grows.     Run the platform as a product.  Partner with the Senior Platform Product Manager, make it easy for teams to put their data on the platform: quick setup, fast reviews, clear documentation, and a say in how the platform develops. Work with data producers, Analytics Engineering and other Statista group companies as partners, not just users.     Build trust into the platform.  Guide the use of access controls, cost safeguards, audits, data contracts and metadata so teams can share data safely with people, APIs and AI-powered applications.     Own reliable event streaming.  Run Kafka as the backbone that distributes data and content across Statista: reliable, well monitored, and easy for teams to publish to and consume from.     Set technical direction.  Guide architecture and build-versus-buy decisions, review designs and pull requests, and use AI and automation where they improve the team's work. You'll stay technically engaged without being expected to code every day.        Your Skills     At least five years of experience leading engineering teams, ideally in data platforms, platform engineering or infrastructure. You know how to develop senior engineers and unite people with different technical backgrounds.    A strong foundation in data or platform engineering, with the confidence to contribute to architecture discussions and design reviews. You're familiar with cloud data warehouses, ideally Snowflake, and tools or practices such as dbt and orchestration.    Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform. You're comfortable with Kubernetes, CI/CD and AWS.    Experience operating event-streaming systems such as Kafka, Amazon MSK, Confluent or Redpanda, including a schema registry.   Palmstreet  is the #1 live shopping platform for rare plants, handmade crafts, & unique goods. Founded in 2020 by Instagram and Apple veterans, Palmstreet began as a plant identification app and quickly evolved into a trailblazer in live shopping, beginning with plant sellers. Fueled by a passionate, plant-loving community, we rapidly expanded into new categories to better serve our fast-growing audience. 
 Our vision is to become the “World’s Online Main Street,” bringing the charm of in-person shopping to engaging, social online experiences. Backed by top Silicon Valley VCs and powered by a nimble, empathetic team, we’ve grown our GMV by 500x in the last 18 months. 
 As we continue shaping the future of social commerce, we’re looking for talented individuals who are excited to grow with us and join our mission. 

  The Opportunity:  
 Palmstreet is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the team on key architectural decisions, work on core user experiences like instant bidding and live interactions, develop scalable architecture to handle millions of users, innovate core features like live streaming and checkout processes, and maintain a reliable deployment pipeline. 

  Responsibilities:  
 
 
 Build and maintain robust backend services and APIs that power both web and mobile applications using Node.js 
 
 
 Work closely with PM and design to build scalable products and services 
 
 
 Establish self as an owner of a particular component, feature, or system with expert end-to-end understanding 
 
 
 Successfully complete projects at large scope while maintaining a consistently high level of productivity 
 
 
 Take active ownership of DevOps responsibilities including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure management, deployment automation, and system reliability 
 
 
 Leverage AI coding tools (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) to accelerate development velocity and improve code quality 
 
 
  Qualifications:  
 
 
 BS (or higher) in Computer Science 
 
 
 Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin 
 
 
 5+ years experience building highly scalable and reliable infrastructure 
 
 
 Payment system experience preferred 
 
 
 Hands-on DevOps experience: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and cloud platforms (GCP/AWS) 
 
 
 Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) preferred 
 
 
 Experience building high-concurrency systems preferred 
 
 
  Preferred Qualifications:  
 
 
 Experience creating web interfaces using  React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript  to integrate with backend services 
 
 
  Your Location:  
 
 
 Remote - Anywhere in the China 
 
 
  Compensation:  
 
 
 Salary range: 600k - 1M RMB / year. 
 
 
 5 insurances + 1 housing fund(五险一金) included 
 
 
 Equity grants will also be provided as part of the total compensation package. 
 
 
  Why Join Us?  
 
 
  Shape the future of live shopping : Be part of a dynamic team revolutionizing the online shopping experience, combining creativity and technology to create immersive, interactive platforms for sellers and buyers alike. 
 
 
  Collaborate with industry pioneers : Work alongside a nimble, innovative team, backed by some of the most prestigious VCs in Silicon Valley, with opportunities to influence the product direction. 
 
 
  Solving complex challenges:  You'll take on complex problems that others haven't yet been able to solve, driving innovation and pushing boundaries in your work. 
 
 
  Thrive in a flat, startup environment:  Take full ownership of your projects while working alongside a supportive team that values collaboration and mutual respect.

In der ersten Hälfte führst du mich durch ein Projekt, das du gebaut hast: Architektur, Entscheidungen, was du heute anders machen würdest. In der zweiten Hälfte öffne ich unser Monorepo, zeige dir, wie wir arbeiten und deployen, und du stellst Fragen. Kein Live-Coding, kein Algorithmen-Quiz.    Ein bezahlter Probetag. new_jobs.description: At  Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. You’ll work closely with the Senior Platform Product Manager: they lead product vision and priorities; you lead the people, technical delivery and day-to-day operation of the platform. The role spans Snowflake-based data infrastructure and event streaming via Kafka.      What You’ll Do      Lead and grow the team.  Lead a mixed team of DevOps, software and data engineers with shared ownership, on-call and standards. Grow people through clear expectations, regular feedback and real ownership, and hire as the platform grows.     Run the platform as a product.  Partner with the Senior Platform Product Manager, make it easy for teams to put their data on the platform: quick setup, fast reviews, clear documentation, and a say in how the platform develops. Work with data producers, Analytics Engineering and other Statista group companies as partners, not just users.     Build trust into the platform.  Guide the use of access controls, cost safeguards, audits, data contracts and metadata so teams can share data safely with people, APIs and AI-powered applications.     Own reliable event streaming.  Run Kafka as the backbone that distributes data and content across Statista: reliable, well monitored, and easy for teams to publish to and consume from.     Set technical direction.  Guide architecture and build-versus-buy decisions, review designs and pull requests, and use AI and automation where they improve the team's work. You'll stay technically engaged without being expected to code every day.        Your Skills     At least five years of experience leading engineering teams, ideally in data platforms, platform engineering or infrastructure. You know how to develop senior engineers and unite people with different technical backgrounds.    A strong foundation in data or platform engineering, with the confidence to contribute to architecture discussions and design reviews. You're familiar with cloud data warehouses, ideally Snowflake, and tools or practices such as dbt and orchestration.    Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform. You're comfortable with Kubernetes, CI/CD and AWS.    Experience operating event-streaming systems such as Kafka, Amazon MSK, Confluent or Redpanda, including a schema registry. You use AI tools and agentic workflows in your daily work and help your team do the same. new_jobs.description: Remote in Deutschland · Vollzeit · €85.000–100.000 + 1,0–1,5 % Anteile  Warum es diese Stelle gibt  Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz, sind profitabel und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat behandeln.  Jetzt bereiten wir unsere Seed-Runde vor. Ich bin Jan, der technische Gründer, und bis heute der einzige Vollzeit-Entwickler. Ich suche die Person, die diesen Job von mir übernimmt: den Stack verantworten, Features bauen und deployen, das Team koordinieren und später mit mir das Engineering-Team aufbauen. Wen wir suchen    Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit produktionsreifer Software, ein guter Teil davon in TypeScript. Du hast schon Verantwortung für Deployments und Infrastruktur getragen.    Du arbeitest täglich mit KI-Coding-Agenten und kannst zeigen, was du damit gebaut hast. Das fragen wir im ersten Gespräch ab.    Docker, CI, Cloud oder Kubernetes hast du schon betrieben. Hilfreich, aber nicht nötig: Expo, Vercel AI SDK  Was wir bieten    €85.000–100.000 Fixgehalt, je nach Erfahrung.    1,0–1,5 % virtuelle Unternehmensanteile (VSOP). Im ersten Gespräch rechnen wir dir vor, was das bei verschiedenen Exits wert ist.    KI-Tooling ohne Budgetgrenze: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Frontier-Modelle.    Remote in Deutschland, regelmäßige Teamtreffen.    Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit beiden Gründern.    Wenn das Team wächst, wirst du Head of Engineering.    30 Tage Urlaub, Hardware nach Wahl.    So bewirbst du dich  Kein Anschreiben. Schick uns hier über join: einen Link zu etwas, das du gebaut hast, ein paar Sätze, warum diese Rolle, und wie du KI in deinem Arbeitsalltag nutzt.  Wir antworten innerhalb von 3-5 Tagen. Dann:    30 Minuten Videocall mit mir. Ich erzähle dir, was wir bauen, wie die Zahlen aussehen und warum es diese Stelle gibt. Du erzählst mir, was du zuletzt gebaut hast und was du suchst. Danach wissen wir beide, ob es Sinn ergibt weiterzumachen.    60 Minuten technisches Gespräch. In der ersten Hälfte führst du mich durch ein Projekt, das du gebaut hast: Architektur, Entscheidungen, was du heute anders machen würdest. In der zweiten Hälfte öffne ich unser Monorepo, zeige dir, wie wir arbeiten und deployen, und du stellst Fragen. Kein Live-Coding, kein Algorithmen-Quiz.    Ein bezahlter Probetag. Du bekommst ein echtes Ticket aus unserem Backlog und eine Entwicklungsumgebung mit Testdaten. Du arbeitest mit deinen eigenen Tools, so wie du es sonst auch tust, und am Ende reviewen wir deinen PR gemeinsam.
